correctness.rationale: For every prime power q and m,n>=2, independently counted the rank-one shell via uv^T with q-1 factorizations to recover Delsarte’s formula S_r=(q^(m+n-r)-q^m-q^n+1)/(q-1). Frequency differences from the zero-plus-one-coordinate band have rank 0,1,2, giving D=qt I+t(R⊗J_z)+c2 J. Diagonalization of the rook matrix yields label-contrast qt [mn(q-2)], row (1+zn)t [m-1], column (1+zm)t [n-1], and interaction t [(m-1)(n-1)]. Constant and zero-frequency modes form the exact 2×2 block [[1,c1√T],[c1√T,B]] with roots λ±, so dimensions total 1+mn(q−1). Its determinant Var_X(T−q support(u)support(v))/T>0, since support products vary when m,n≥2; all eigenvalues positive. Parseval and Rayleigh give sharp energy concentration and squared condition number; exact trace/determinant expansion at fixed q and m=n=d gives λ+~(q−1)d²/q², λ−~2(q−1)/d, κ²~d³/(2q²). Independent direct character enumeration of 8 (q,m,n) cases including GF(4) matched full eigenspectra (maximum error 2.22e−15); finite tests corroborate and do not establish the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The rank-one (Segre) variety is a canonical finite-field matrix variety and the complete constant-plus-one-entry additive Fourier band is a natural first-order harmonic model. The theorem gives a genuine full exact spectral classification, every equality subspace, uniform injectivity and the sharp concentration operator norm, while quantifying significant cubic squared-conditioning deterioration. The Fourier kernel alone is known; a coordinate-specific compressed Gram spectrum and its stability were not a textbook rank-character lookup or unmotivated arbitrary slice. The precise spectral data may be used in finite-field Fourier interpolation, structured sensing or stability analysis without claiming optimal frequency design or higher-degree results.
residual_risks: No optimal choice of Fourier band is proved and no implication for all matrix ranks or all frequency supports.
Potential unindexed equivalent compression could alter the novelty/value judgment if subsequently verified.

limitations: Claim only for exact rank-one rectangular shell, constant and every one-entry character; q prime power, m,n≥2.
Delsarte Fourier rank-one sum is known prior art; originality is additional coordinate Gram compression/equality spaces/conditioning, with older implicit literature risk.
Eight direct finite cases and asymptotic diagnostics corroborate analytic proof but do not certify universal statements.
No formal Lean or external expert attestation; no results for arbitrary frequency bands, rank strata or optimal sensing designs.
